translation: [timer_str]

source: Great work! It looks just like I remember!
translation: 干得漂亮！和我记忆中的一模一样！

source: That’s everything – it’s good as new!
translation: 全都找到了——现在焕然一新了！

source: Wow, great job! I had forgotten most of those!
translation: 哇，干得好！好多细节我都忘了！

source: Oh, you’re right – we’ve never tolerated littering at the camp!
translation: 对，你说得没错——营地里从来不允许乱扔垃圾！

source: Bananas are my favorite fruit…
translation: 香蕉是我最喜欢的水果……

source: Right! I was carrying a backpack since I’d just arrived!
translation: 对！我那时刚到营地，背着背包！

source: I really liked that backpack too, but there's more!
translation: 我也很喜欢那个背包，不过还不止这一处！

source: Oh yeah, Sir Goro's gloves!
translation: 对了，还有Goro教官的手套！

source: It fits like a glove because it is a glove.
translation: 戴起来当然合手，因为它本来就是手套。

source: Yuri does always wear a hat with her uniform!
translation: Yuri穿制服时确实一直戴着帽子！

source: It does look quite natural on her, doesn’t it?
translation: 看起来确实很自然，对吧？

source: Sir Goro's hair used to be a nice shade of pink!
translation: Goro教官以前的头发是漂亮的粉色！

source: Pink really suited him, huh?
translation: 粉色真的很适合他，对吧？

source: Now that's a regularly shaped cloud.
translation: 这才是形状正常的云。

source: I -I wish all clouds were shaped like that…
translation: 我、我真希望所有云都是这种形状……

source: How did that end up upside down?!
translation: 那东西怎么倒过来了？！

source: The star is an important symbol of the camp.
translation: 星星是营地的重要象征。

source: That was definitely a mistake...
translation: 那肯定是弄错了……

source: Thanks for pointing that out!
translation: 谢谢你指出来！

source: That stone looked quite different...
translation: 那块石头看起来很不一样……

source: You'll need a stronger pickaxe to mine that!
translation: 你得用更结实的镐才能把它挖下来！

source: Rainbows that break the law end up going to prism.
translation: 违法的彩虹最后都会被关进“棱镜”里。

source: I was actually really happy that day!
translation: 我那天其实真的很开心！

source: The more you click won’t make him blink.
translation: 你再怎么点，他也不会眨眼。

source: Yeah, Aiden’s bag was green!
translation: 对，Aiden的包是绿色的！

source: Isn’t that his favorite color…?
translation: 那不是他最喜欢的颜色吗……？

source: I think I dropped off my bag in the tent too…
translation: 我记得我也把包放进帐篷了……

source: What’s in the bag…?
translation: 包里有什么……？

source: We set up the tents during the day, right!
translation: 对，我们是在白天搭帐篷的！

source: It would’ve been much harder to do after dark.
translation: 天黑后搭起来会难得多。

source: I definitely had my scarf on!
translation: 我肯定戴着围巾！

source: T- The uniform does look odd without a scarf…
translation: 制、制服没有围巾确实很奇怪……

source: Those tents were brand new then – there wasn’t a tear.
translation: 那时帐篷还是全新的——没有破口。

source: Y-You probably would’ve fixed any tears…
translation: 有、有破口的话你肯定早就补好了……

source: GAH! Why would we bring that?!
translation: 啊！我们怎么会把那东西带来？！

source: S-Something tells me Yuri was behind that one…
translation: 我、我总觉得那是Yuri搞的……

source: Right, Aiden’s ears weren’t pierced yet!
translation: 对，Aiden那时还没打耳洞！

source: I like the way they look on him now.
translation: 我喜欢他现在戴耳饰的样子。

source: Pfft, that was an easy one!
translation: 噗，这个太简单了！

source: It looks way more cheerful like this.
translation: 这样看起来欢快多了。

source: Something’s off, but I can’t stripe put my finger on it…
translation: 有点不对劲，但我就是找不出那条差别……

source: The recipe did not have eggplants in it.
translation: 食谱里没有茄子。

source: Eggplants or bananas… Hmmm…
translation: 茄子还是香蕉……嗯……

source: Mr. Andre never wore a hat!
translation: Andre先生从来不戴帽子！

source: It looked kinda silly that way, didn’t it?
translation: 那样看着有点傻，对吧？

source: Mr. Andre was a clean cook, so there wasn’t any dripping!
translation: Andre先生做饭很讲卫生，不会滴得到处都是！

source: T-There’s usually not a mess in the kitchen.
translation: 厨、厨房里一般不会这么乱。

source: Hmm, the floor does look strange here…
translation: 嗯，这里的地板看起来确实很奇怪……

source: Those floorboards aren’t really that interesting…
translation: 那些地板也没什么好看的……

source: He looks good, but he was wearing his usual shorts.
translation: 他看起来很帅，但当时穿的是平常那条短裤。

source: There’s no way the camp could afford a golden bowl.
translation: 营地不可能买得起金碗。

source: Regular bowl halftime show.
translation: 普通碗中场秀。

source: I’m sure the windows were clean that day!
translation: 我确定那天窗户很干净！

source: Squeaky clean!
translation: 一尘不染！

source: The windows don’t open in there!
translation: 那里的窗户打不开！

source: No wonder it gets so hot…
translation: 难怪里面那么热……

source: Mr. Andre was very professional, no way he'd wear that!
translation: Andre先生很专业，绝不会穿成那样！

source: Is it just me, or does that look like Aiden?
translation: 是我的错觉，还是那东西看起来像Aiden？

source: I-I don't like slithering things...
translation: 我、我不喜欢扭来扭去的东西……

source: I don’t remember this beach having shells…
translation: 我不记得这片海滩上有贝壳……

source: There’s no more sea shells by the sea shore.
translation: 海边已经没有贝壳了。

source: GAH! There definitely wasn’t a shark!
translation: 啊！那里绝对没有鲨鱼！

source: I hope one wasn’t swimming around you...
translation: 希望当时没有鲨鱼在你身边游……

source: H-How would that even have gotten there…?
translation: 那、那东西到底怎么会跑到那里……？

source: Maybe one of the campers was playing a prank…
translation: 也许是哪个童军在恶作剧……

source: Right! Aiden had a really cool shell necklace!
translation: 对！Aiden那时戴着一条很酷的贝壳项链！

source: I think it looks good on him too.
translation: 我也觉得很适合他。

source: My shorts were definitely yellow!
translation: 我的短裤肯定是黄色的！

source: Yellow… It’s me…
translation: 黄色……是我……

source: The sun was different somehow…
translation: 太阳好像有哪里不一样……

source: It looks really hot there…
translation: 那里看起来真的很热……

source: There definitely weren’t seagulls around.
translation: 那里肯定没有海鸥。

source: Bird poop would’ve been gross…
translation: 鸟粪会很恶心……

source: Careful, the needles can be really pine-ful!
translation: 小心，松针扎起来可真“松”疼！

source: I don't think that kind of pines grow there...
translation: 我觉得那里长的不是这种松树……

source: There wasn't a (grey) cloud in the sky!
translation: 天空中没有（灰色的）云！

source: No (grey) clouds allowed in the sky!
translation: 天空不准出现（灰色的）云！

source: Its name is Kiwi. Kiwi the frog.
translation: 它叫Kiwi，是只名叫Kiwi的青蛙。

source: Kiwi likes bugs.
translation: Kiwi喜欢虫子。

source: Aiden’s skin glistened in the full moon!
translation: Aiden的皮肤在满月下闪闪发亮！

source: Yeah, green looks better on him!
translation: 对，绿色更适合他！

source: All that glitters is not gold.
translation: 闪光的未必都是金子。

source: There definitely wasn’t anything like that on his staff!
translation: 他的手杖上绝对没有那种东西！

source: Does anyone know puns about cobras? Because I serpently don’t.
translation: 谁知道眼镜蛇的双关？反正我“蛇么”也想不出来。

source: My sheriff bandana was red!
translation: 我的警长头巾是红色的！

source: The moon reflected on the water surface!
translation: 月亮倒映在水面上！

source: {image=images/jmg/note.png} When will my reflection show who I am inside? {image=images/jmg/note.png}
translation: {image=images/jmg/note.png} 我的倒影何时才能映出真实的自己？ {image=images/jmg/note.png}

source: Lately I've been losing sleep counting stars...
translation: 最近我数星星数到睡不着……

source: There was no star there, you two were the stars that night.
translation: 那里原本没有星星，那晚你们俩才是最耀眼的星。

source: Mmh, that's a new patch of sand!
translation: 嗯，那是一块新出现的沙地！

source: Is this a patch note?
translation: 这是补丁说明吗？

source: We can always use some extra wood!
translation: 多些木头总能派上用场！

source: Wood you like to click somewhere else?
translation: 你“木”不能点点别处？

source: It would be hard to chop wood with that…
translation: 用那个劈柴会很困难……

source: Careful with that!
translation: 小心点！

source: Fruit Ninja!
translation: 水果忍者！

source: Now that’s pear-fect!
translation: 这下可真是“梨”想状态！

source: Sir Goro always wears black leather!
translation: Goro教官总是穿黑色皮革！

source: Are you ready, boots?
translation: 靴子们，准备好了吗？

source: Not that much of a difference, but Lloyd was young back then!
translation: 差别不大，不过Lloyd那时还年轻！

source: He didn’t grow an inch taller, did he?
translation: 他一点都没长高，对吧？

source: Black looks good on Darius.
translation: Darius穿黑色很好看。

source: Back in black?
translation: 又是一身黑？

source: Don’t crack those eggs!
translation: 别打碎那些鸡蛋！

source: That’s a coccinella septempuntata! They bring good luck!
translation: 那是七星瓢虫！它们会带来好运！

source: It probably hid somewhere…
translation: 它大概躲到哪儿去了……

source: We just had started chopping!
translation: 我们才刚开始砍！

source: It's beautiful, but that wasn't there.
translation: 它很漂亮，但原来不在那里。

source: It flew away.
translation: 它飞走了。

source: Sir Goro’s hair is styled the other way.
translation: Goro教官的头发是往另一边梳的。

source: I like him better like this.
translation: 我更喜欢他现在这样。

source: No one had party hats on that day.
translation: 那天没人戴派对帽。

source: You’ve got something in your hair, Yoshi…
translation: Yoshi，你头发上有东西……

source: The cake was vanilla flavored!
translation: 蛋糕是香草味的！

source: The banners have always been plain.
translation: 横幅一直都是素色的。

source: There’s a lot of rainbow flags here.
translation: 这里有很多彩虹旗。

source: Happy bow-day, Sir Goro!
translation: Goro教官，祝你“结”日快乐！

source: Yuri always had her hairclip on!
translation: Yuri一直戴着发夹！

source: {image=images/jmg/note.png} Fly like a butterfly, wings, wings {image=images/jmg/note.png}
translation: {image=images/jmg/note.png} 像蝴蝶一样飞翔，挥动翅膀，挥动翅膀 {image=images/jmg/note.png}

source: The confetti weren’t star shaped.
translation: 彩纸不是星形的。

source: Sir Goro was the only star that day.
translation: 那天Goro教官才是唯一的明星。

source: That was pretty mean... No one in the camp would do that.
translation: 那也太过分了……营地里没人会这么做。

source: We didn't have budget for that many gifts!
translation: 我们没预算买那么多礼物！

source: I'd know a perfect gift for Sir Goro...
translation: 我知道什么礼物最适合Goro教官……

source: Our woods have plenty of trees!
translation: 我们的树林里有很多树！

source: Right! The tree only had two coconuts!
translation: 对！那棵树上只有两个椰子！

source: It’s a rock.
translation: 这是块石头。

source: Yeah, that area was grassy too.
translation: 对，那一带当时也长满了草。

source: Gor geous w-shaped bush.
translation: 真是“Gor”丽的W形灌木丛。

source: I think I was really embarrassed that time...
translation: 我记得那次我真的很尴尬……

source: I-I doubt you were cranky that day…
translation: 我、我觉得你那天应该没那么暴躁……

source: Yuri made a flower necklace for Sir Goro, not me.
translation: Yuri给Goro教官做的是花环，不是给我的。

source: There’s no way someone carved that out here.
translation: 不可能有人在这里刻出那种东西。

source: Keep palm and carry on.
translation: 保持“棕”容，继续前行。

source: K-Keitaro?! He definitely wasn’t there!!
translation: K-Keitaro？！他当时肯定不在那里！！

source: I don't think there's a cave there.
translation: 我觉得那里没有洞穴。

source: Sir Goro's shirt had a plant pattern!
translation: Goro教官的衬衫上是植物图案！

source: The eyes are missing something!
translation: 眼睛少了点什么！

source: The eyes are the windows to the soul.
translation: 眼睛是心灵的窗户。

source: It’s already hard with 3 cards, I don’t want to play with just 2!
translation: 三张牌已经很难了，我可不想只用两张玩！

source: Shoulder? You barely know her!
translation: 肩膀？你都还不怎么认识她呢！

source: THAT SPIDER HAD BETTER NOT MOVE!
translation: 那只蜘蛛最好别动！

source: With great spider comes great responsibility…
translation: 蜘蛛越大，责任越大……

source: Wormtail?!
translation: Wormtail？！

source: Rat-tat-away.
translation: 鼠鼠快走。

source: What did we even drink that night?
translation: 我们那晚到底喝了什么？

source: I-I think you all had plenty to drink already…
translation: 我、我觉得你们已经喝得够多了……

source: I-I'm not that fat!! R-Right?
translation: 我、我没那么胖！！对、对吧？

source: Those hips don't lie.
translation: 这些胯不会说谎。

source: There was a crate there!
translation: 那里原本有个木箱！

source: Crate job!
translation: “箱”当不错！

source: Oh no! I think we damaged the picture too much…
translation: 糟了！我们好像把图片破坏得太严重了……

source: Hmm... I can’t remember what else was wrong... That’s too bad.
translation: 嗯……我想不起来还有哪里不对了……太可惜了。

source: Are you sure you want to skip the Journal Minigame? You will not earn gallery coins and will skip the proceeding flashback sequence.
translation: 你确定要跳过日志小游戏吗？你将无法获得画廊硬币，并且会跳过接下来的闪回序列。
